Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Los Angeles Domestic Partners Bill 2. The American Civil Liberty's Union anti-discrimination project 3. Boston demonstrators protest against anti-gay foster parent legislation 4. Andy Hum on Father's Day COMMERCIAL: Brunch Buddies 5. Harvard researchers announce they have blood test for AIDS which can also detect the virus in carriers, eliminates false positives 6. Bathhouses promote safe-sex in conference, interview with Mike Fesco, Atlanta Manager of Club Baths COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 7. Booksellers ban 8. Texas students throw beer cans at gay pride float 8. Tom Cuite resigns COMMERCIAL: Chamberlain and Associates, career service professionals 9. Sports, "we are the world" clip COMMERCIAL: "The Connection," gay and lesbian newspaper 10. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Interview with Dr. Dan William, board member of New York Physicians for Human Rights, discusses antiviral agents and Isoprinosine 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Media report/current events/culture, includes clips COMMERCIAL: "Manscape," a gay magazine 2. Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: Brunch Buddies 3. Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: Carnaval in Rio de Janeiro, Islanders' Club 4. Sybil Bruncheon COMMERCIAL: Arco Blancos resort, San Juan, Puerto Rico 5. Closing credits
